run_f_gold: run f_gold to compute the lexicographically next string from a given input string
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple input strings and compare results with a candidate implementation
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to handle edge cases like empty strings or non-alphabetic characters
review_f_gold: review f_gold algorithm that increments the rightmost non-z character or appends a
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which finds the lexicographically next string by scanning from the end
